seed_facts.quota_verbatim: No stated quota. Seven directories, one of which holds a single 50 MB KMS activator archive. Trivial volume
seed_facts.chaining_verbatim: Read-only and negligible in volume. Included because provider Local with version dev is the profile signature of a self-hosted personal instance, and a Local-backed AList that flips write to true is the main find in this population
seed_facts.reliability_verbatim: Alive, a cosmetic site. The Local backend is the interesting property: it is somebody's own disk served directly, which is the same architecture as the one writable host in the population minus the write permission
seed_facts.tooling_verbatim: the AList REST API anonymously, on a build whose version string is 'dev'
seed_facts.binding_note_verbatim: A Local backend means the operator could grant writes with one checkbox, and this one has not. What binds is the permission, and the corpus is too small to matter either way.
